title: Air-fryer scallops
subtitle: King scallops seared in the air fryer with a caramelised crust.
excerpt: King scallops dried and air-fried at high heat until caramelised on the cut face with an opaque, just-cooked centre. Ready in 6 minutes. Serves two as a starter.
sourceNotes: Scallops are a shellfish found in cold Atlantic and North Sea waters. King scallops (Pecten maximus) are the large variety used as a starter in British restaurant cooking. The key to a good sear is thoroughly drying the cut face before cooking.

content.text: Scallops live or die by one thing: how dry the cut face is before it hits heat. Moisture on the surface creates steam, which prevents the caramelisation that gives a scallop its flavour. Pat them dry for a full minute, not a single press. Cook at the highest temperature your air fryer allows ,  220°C if possible. They need only 5-6 minutes total.

items.prepNote: king scallops, roe on or off, thoroughly dried

content.text: Take the {{scallops}} scallops out of the fridge 15 minutes before cooking. Lay them on a double layer of paper towel and press the cut faces firmly with more paper towel. Leave for 5 minutes. Pat again ,  there should be no moisture visible on the surface. Brush just the cut face with {{olive-oil}} of oil. Season with {{sea-salt-flakes}} of flaked salt on the cut face only.

Preheat the air fryer to 220°C. Place the scallops cut-face down in the basket, spaced apart. Cook for 3 minutes without opening. Flip carefully ,  the cut face should be golden with some caramelisation. Cook for a further 2 minutes. Remove immediately. If using butter, place a small piece on each scallop as it comes out. Serve with lemon wedges.

items.fix: The drying stage is the most important step. Take 5 full minutes and use fresh paper towel.
The centre of a scallop should be just opaque, not white all the way through. Pull at 5 minutes; it continues cooking briefly from retained heat.

items.cause: Moved before the crust has fully formed.
items.fix: Do not touch for the full 3 minutes. The scallop will release cleanly once caramelised.

content.text: Air-fryer scallops are a quick restaurant-style starter. Serve on a pool of pea puree with a few pea shoots, or over a small amount of cauliflower puree with pancetta. The same technique works for smaller queen scallops ,  reduce the time to 3 minutes total.
